note: One clan, spelled two ways. The standard is the spelling on the Kiara Combined Forum's list of 30 and 31 October 2026; the recordings keep whatever the steward typed, and this maps the one onto the other at the point where a survey unit is formed. Written one case at a time, from what the reviewer states. Zone always has to match: the same name in two zones is two landholding groups, never one.

held.note: Name queries that are not the reviewer's to settle. Each is two surveys against two similar names on the forum's list, crossed, so picking one pairing picks the other and a wrong guess puts a clan's walking on another clan's page. Held for the zone staff. Nothing is linked and nothing is renamed until they answer.
